description_html:
Project Scope Studio

Prepare consistent estimates with explicit labor, expenses and contingency.

For Freelancers and small project-based service businesses.

  • Labor and cost breakdown
  • Contingency and margin calculation
  • Printable estimate
  • CSV export
  • Offline use

Downloadable offline browser tool. Includes instructions, FAQ and single-business license. Use realistic fictional examples to learn the workflow, then enter your own assumptions. Inputs remain on your device; the product has no server connection. No physical item. Planning aid; verify assumptions independently. Introductory price is a hypothesis, not proven market value.
ai_assistance_disclosure: Created with AI-assisted development and human owner review required.
benefits: Make assumptions explicit before quoting or committing cash
Compare planning scenarios without sharing private records with a server
Retain an export for your own review

competitor_comparison.free_alternatives: A blank spreadsheet or manual calculation can solve parts of this problem. This package supplies a focused interface, validation and instructions. No superiority claim against named paid competitors is established.

manual_requirements: Review current marketplace policy and category
Configure digital fulfillment and test delivery
